desc: The BANISH 12 Choke Mounts are purpose-built for use with the BANISH 12 suppressor, making it easy to securely attach the suppressor to a variety of compatible shotguns. Designed with precision and performance in mind, these mounts are machined from high-strength 17-4 PH stainless steel, offering exceptional durability and reliability even under heavy use. Each mount is finished with a black nitride coating, which provides excellent corrosion resistance and a sleek, professional look. .
